run_ecs_task: run an ECS task on a cluster with a given task definition, container, command, and subnets
describe_ecs_tasks: describe one or more ECS tasks in a cluster and return their container instance details
list_ecs_clusters: list all ECS cluster ARNs or describe clusters filtered by optional tags
describe_ecs_task_definitions: describe ECS task definitions and return container definitions filtered by optional tags
stop_ecs_task: stop a running ECS task in a specified cluster by its task ID
